expectation: The referenced file returns to byte-identical A before commit, while the reader observed B. Before/after hashes must match while hash(reader bytes) differs. This falsifies before/commit fingerprint equality as a proof that those were the read bytes. It does not test a product, actual bind mounts, or fault injection in the candidate runtime.
applicability: Candidate snapshots notebook/code, references data via read-only mounts, and commits on matching input snapshot. Read-only consumer permissions do not constrain an independent writer through the original path; the proposal contains no immutable input-epoch/exclusion requirement for this race.
